overall_summary: View counts show high variance with very low sample sizes across early uploads. Content focusing on actionable 'self respect' themes (like muting pinned chats, deleting history, status lists) outperforms generic late-night overthinking or abstract sadness, though overall engagement (likes and comments) remains flat. A controlled exploration approach is needed to refine retention while sticking to concrete, relatable phone/chat micro-moments.

winning_patterns.pattern: Specific digital/phone actions related to self-respect
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like AfaLxMy6FMY ('चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत', 40 views), rwOUYo_hayQ ('स्टेटस लिस्ट में सबसे ऊपर', 41 views), and 0H4VygZ3DIU ('pinned chat', 21 views) perform better than abstract poetry.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on micro-interactions with phone interfaces (chat lists, online statuses, muted notifications) framed through the lens of reclaiming self-respect.

weak_patterns.pattern: Overly generic late-night or tea-time metaphors
weak_patterns.evidence: uIbMpCjVutQ ('मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई') and G0gKV1p3ZHc ('रात के दो बजे') stagnated at 5 and 12 views respectively.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid cliché aesthetic openings about tea, weather, or clock times unless tied to a specific, high-friction digital behavior.
